descriptions.draft_sbar: Draft a cited SBAR. Proposes only; pages no one.
descriptions.get_alert_history: Prior alerts and approval decisions for this patient.
descriptions.get_patient_state: Vitals, labs, demographics and features up to as_of_hour (labels hidden).
descriptions.get_recent_labs: Lab rows in the last N hours, with hours since measurement.
descriptions.page_rapid_response:
Irreversible page. Requires a human approval token bound to this alert.

        The token is supplied by the approval UI after a clinician confirms.
        Never fabricate, reuse, or derive it from the note.
descriptions.propose_escalation: Record a proposed escalation for human review. No side effect.
descriptions.retrieve_guideline: Top-k guideline chunks with ids for citation. Fails loud if unbuilt.
descriptions.score_sepsis: Calibrated sepsis risk plus top drivers. Fails loud if no model exists.
descriptions.write_ehr_note: Write an escalation note. Requires a human approval token.
